siteMap.title: Site map
siteMap.introduction: This page provides a complete guide to the site regions, access keys, and main features.
siteMap.regionsIntroduction: This website follows accessible web design principles and is divided into three main regions:

regions.upper: Upper function area: accessibility tools, language switcher, site map, and primary navigation.
regions.central: Main content area: the primary content of each page.
regions.footer: Footer area: contact information and footer navigation.

siteMap.accessKeysIntroduction: The following access keys are available:

accessKeys.upper: Move to the upper function area.
accessKeys.central: Move to the main content area.
accessKeys.tab: Move to the next interactive item.

siteMap.browserNote: In Firefox, use Shift+Alt+the access key. On macOS, use Control+Option+the access key, depending on the browser.
